dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: 49ers (8-1) Week 10 Postgame Briefing: 46-40 Win Over Dallas Cowboys
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: San Francisco (8-1) closed out Week 10 with a 46-40 victory over the Dallas Cowboys [49ers.com Official](https://www.49ers.com/news/christian-mccaffrey-keeps-the-records-falling-in-49ers-46-40-win-over-cowboys), strengthening NFC positioning entering Week 11 against the Minnesota Vikings. Postgame evaluations centered on Brock Purdy's pocket execution, Raheem Morris's defensive adjustments, and roster recovery while maintaining $39.18M in 2026 salary cap flexibility [Tim Kawakami](https://bsky.app/profile/timkawakami.bsky.social/post/3n2h5hkzzx22m).
bullets: Postgame Execution & Film Takeaways: Kyle Shanahan's offense balanced situational run efficiency and intermediate passing against the Dallas Cowboys [49ers Webzone](https://www.49erswebzone.com/articles/205213-49ers-warner-doesnt-brock-league/), while Raheem Morris leaned on disciplined secondary coverage and interior disruption to close out critical second-half possessions [Kerry Crowley](https://sfstandard.com/2026/11/16/brock-purdy-brian-flores-49ers-vikings/).

Postgame Health & Week 11 Recovery: Medical staff monitor WR Mike Evans (Achilles) and CB Nate Hobbs (groin) coming out of Week 10 while CB Nate Hobbs's 21-day IR practice window remains active ahead of early-week evaluations for the Minnesota Vikings [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/will-levis-jimmy-garoppolo-among-possible-qb-options-for-patriots/).

Cap Rollover & Week 11 Outlook: Paraag Marathe preserves $39.18M in 2026 gross cap space for 1-for-1 CBA Article 13 rollover against 2027's -$36.74M void years projection as San Francisco prepares for the Minnesota Vikings [Matt Maiocco](https://bsky.app/profile/mattmaiocco.bsky.social/post/3n2gzerhbvs2o).

rawStream.title: The 49ers reinstated Aiyuk (personal) from the reserve/left squad list Monday and were granted a two-week roster exemption for the wide receiver.
rawStream.summary: In what amounted to a procedural transaction after Aiyuk met with team officials Friday upon filing his paperwork for reinstatement, the 49ers now have until Nov. 23 to add him to the 53-man roster, release him or trade him. Given that Aiyuk owes the 49ers roughly $13 million in bonus forfeiture, securing a release from the team could prove difficult, though it's possible that the two sides work out a repayment plan that would allow him to become a free agent. In addition to the financial complications potentially delaying Aiyuk's return to the field, it's unclear if the 49ers or any other team have interest in rostering the 28-year-old wideout, who hasn't played an NFL snap since tearing the ACL and MCL in his right knee Oct. 20, 2024 and undergoing surgery.
rawStream.author: Tom Pelissero
